text: The authors follow Saunders et al. in training an autoregressive policy that takes a (question, answer) pair and outputs a critique pointing out errors, but unlike Saunders et al. they train it with RLHF on challenging real-world data, and report that the resulting GPT-4-based CriticGPT outperforms representative humans at challenging bug detection.
title: McAleese et al. extend Saunders et al.'s critique models with RLHF on real-world code
